comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
NPC Location: Boston, near bank
Found only on certain days of the NA event cycle.

Contents: Feathered Tunic x1 Special Fore Full Rigged Sail (+20v +28h -1turn) x1, Silver Tarot x1, Improved steel sheet x1, Bagel sandwich (+90 fleet vig food) x50, 3* Large Ship Blueprints x1, +30% speed boost 1h x1, Veil of Dominions (1hr) x1, PO1 x10, PO2 x10, PO3 x10, PO4 x10

Feathered Tunic is memorial album entry for the "Rare Items Traveled by Train" MA (new MA that gives Dragoon Revolver, 60att handgun +2 gunfire +2 sniping +2 arms)

Note 1: This is arguably the best mystery bonanza box due to bagel sandwich, silver tarots, improved steel sheets.
Note 2: The day after this NPC emerges, San Francisco will have 1 nanban good available for direct purchase from market keeper.
